description: This header file defines interfaces and structures for system-level operations in the reftable library, including temporary file management, random number generation, and file locking mechanisms, specifically tailored for integration with Git.

methods.name: tmpfile_from_pattern
methods.description: Creates a temporary file based on a pattern, initializes the reftable_tmpfile structure.

methods.name: tmpfile_close
methods.description: Closes the temporary file's descriptor without deleting the file.

methods.name: tmpfile_rename
methods.description: Renames the temporary file to a specified path.

methods.name: flock_acquire
methods.description: Acquires a lock on a target path, with optional timeout.

methods.name: flock_close
methods.description: Closes the lock file descriptor without releasing the lock.

methods.name: flock_release
methods.description: Releases the lock by unlinking the lock file.

methods.name: flock_commit
methods.description: Commits the lock by renaming the lock file into place.
